label: Tax-financed automatic liquidity
summary: Fund bounded automatic liquidity from a disclosed portion of collected token transfer tax.
requiredFacts: Tax fraction reserved for liquidity, accumulator asset, threshold, cadence and maximum inventory
Exact swap and add-liquidity sequence, price limits, slippage, deadline and partial-failure behavior
Who can trigger, pause, rescue or reconfigure execution and how accumulated value exits
LP position owner, fee beneficiary, lock or removal rules and treatment during retirement
Ordering between tax accounting, platform liabilities, swaps, settlement and liquidity creation
requiredTests: Accumulator boundaries immediately below, at and above the execution threshold
Repeated, partial, reverted and adversarially ordered execution without double counting
Price manipulation, sandwich, slippage, deadline, zero-liquidity and callback-recursion failures
Conservation across token tax, platform share, project liabilities and liquidity inventory
LP creation, fee collection, removal, rescue, pause and user-exit lifecycle
risks: Predictable tax-funded swaps can be sandwiched or manipulated around thresholds
Cross-feature reentrancy or accounting order can double spend accumulated tax
Unclear LP custody or rescue authority can redirect or strand user-funded value
